sloka: स तस्य बाहुर्गिरिशृङ्गकल्पः समुद्गरो राघवबाणकृत्तः।पपात तस्मिन् हरिराजसैन्ये जघान तां वानरवाहनीं च ।। ६.६७.१४५ ।।
transliteration: sa tasya bāhurgiriśṛṅgakalpaḥ samudgaro rāghavabāṇakṛttaḥ।papāta tasmin harirājasainye jaghāna tāṁ vānaravāhanīṁ ca ।। 6.67.145 ।।

translations.english: Enraged by the loud sound of the twang of the bow, the bull among Rakshasas unable to bear rushed towards Raghava.
